name: Weapon Familiarity
body:
Weapon Familiarity (Ex)
Source Disciple's Doctrine pg. 23
The vigilante selects either two simple or martial weapons or one exotic weapon when he gains this talent. He gains proficiency with his chosen weapon or weapons. At 8th level, he also gains Weapon Focus as a bonus feat for his selected weapon or weapons. Only an avenger vigilante can select this talent.
